mutations.name: the page drops the date the query names
kills: the coordinator page draws one meter per account with its reserve, target and guard markers, for the day the query names

mutations.name: a failed pools read hides the cards too
kills: the coordinator page confines a failed pools read to one alert in its own section and still draws the cards

mutations.name: an unreported cost reads as zero dollars
kills: the coordinator page shows a coordinator whose agents reported no cost as n/a, not as $0.00

mutations.name: the unattributed PRs are not shown
kills: the coordinator page gives each coordinator a card with its seat, agents, cost and merged PRs, and groups the unowned PRs apart
the coordinator page while loading or degraded says why every PR is unattributed when events.db cannot be read

mutations.name: a pools gap is shown raw, with no word on what it leaves unknown
kills: the coordinator page while loading or degraded explains in words what a missing pace.json leaves unknown, and keeps the account's own error
